description: This PHP script (jp.php) serves as a command-line utility for executing JMESPath expressions on JSON input data or running compliance tests based on provided scripts, test suites, and cases. It includes functionality for locating autoload files, parsing command-line arguments, loading test data, and executing the specified JMESPath expressions using the JmesPath PHP library.

classes.name: DebugRuntime
classes.description: A class that extends JmesPath Runtime to include debugging features during the execution of JMESPath expressions.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A class providing environment setup for JmesPath, including the creation of runtime instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes a JMESPath expression with the given input data, with added debugging capabilities.
